name: ans_1_pre_desc
value: - The Manual Location feature allows users to edit and customize the location details stamped on their photos. This feature is particularly useful for adding personalized addresses to photos taken for events, business purposes, or creative projects.

name: ans_1_pre_desc_1
value: ✦ How to use the Manual Location feature?

name: ans_1_que_1
value: ✦ What does “In Range” Manual Location mean?

name: ans_1_que_1_ans
value: - “In Range” means you’ve added a Manual Location with a specific range (like 100m), and your current location is inside that range.

name: ans_1_que_2
value: ✦ What is an \"Out of Range\" Manual Location?

name: ans_1_que_2_ans
value: - \"Out of Range\" means you’ve added Manual Locations, but your current location is not inside the range of any of added manual location. Since your current location is outside the range of all Manual Locations, you cannot use them on your photos until you move closer to one of those locations.

name: ans_1_que_3
value: "✦ Why can't I select an Out of Range Manual Location?"

name: ans_1_que_3_ans
value: "- You cannot select an Out of Range Manual Location because your current location is outside the range you set for manual locations. Once you're inside the range, you’ll be able to select and use that Manual Location on your photos."

name: ans_1_que_4
value: ✦ What is the purpose of setting a range for Manual Locations?

name: ans_1_que_4_ans
value: - The range ensures that you are physically inside the location range you set. This keeps your photos authentic by making sure the address stamped on the photo matches where you are. You need to be within the specified range (for example, 100m) to use the Manual Location.

name: ans_1_que_5
value: ✦ How does the Manual Location feature improve photo authenticity?

name: ans_1_que_5_ans
value: - By requiring you to be physically within range of the location you set, the feature ensures that the address stamped on your photos is accurate and can’t be manipulated. This adds authenticity and trustworthiness to your work photos, as the location data is real.

name: ans_1_que_6
value: ✦ Why can’t I change the short address (City, State, Country) in Manual Locations?

name: ans_1_que_6_ans
value: - To maintain location accuracy, the short address (City, State, Country) cannot be changed. This ensures the photo’s location is real and prevents from stamping photos with false or incorrect city or country information.

name: ans_1_que_7
value: ✦ Can I use Manual Locations without visiting the actual place?

name: ans_1_que_7_ans
value: - No, you must visit the actual place and be within the range you set to use a Manual Location. This ensures that the address stamped on your photos reflects the real location where the photo was taken.

name: ans_1_que_8
value: ✦ Can I add a Manual Location for a different place while I’m at my current location?

name: ans_1_que_8_ans
value: "- Yes, you can add a Manual Location for another place while you’re at your current location. However, you will only be able to use that Manual Location when you are physically near that place and within the range you set. If you are not in the range of that location, you won't be able to use it to stamp photos."

name: ans_1_step_1_desc
value: - Find + and tap to add the Manual Location.

name: ans_1_step_4_desc
value: - Choose a radius for the range (for example, 100m). This means you have to be within that distance from the location to use it.

value: - You can change the detailed address.

name: ans_1_step_6_desc_1
value: - After filling in the details, tap \"✔\".

name: ans_1_step_6_desc_2
value: - Your manual location is now added!

name: ans_1_step_7_desc
value: - You can see and use the Manual Location feature when you are physically in range of the manually added locations.

name: answer_1_desc_6
value: - Give the location a name. This can be anything you like to help you remember it.
